metadata.title: PyBIDS: Python tools for BIDS datasets

description.en: A short and simple permissive license with conditions only requiring preservation of copyright and license notices. Licensed works, modifications, and larger works may be distributed under different terms and without source code.

metadata.description: PyBIDS is a Python library to centralize interactions with datasets conforming BIDS (Brain Imaging Data Structure) format. For more information about BIDS visit bids.neuroimaging.io.

access_status.description_l10n: The record and files are publicly accessible.
